decisions.reason: The About page currently states $20 and $35 coded-referral commissions; the client-established $12 commission necessarily makes both copies stale.

source_message.speaker: client

value_updates.coded_referral_commission_copy: State that an accepted referral pays an immediate, unlimited $12 commission to the chosen referrer.
value_updates.coded_referral_rewards_copy: State that using an accepted referral code gives the chosen referrer four tickets and a $12 commission.
